verdict.rationale: Puzzle documents its own bulk operations: batch categorization of transactions, CSV batch import of manual journal entries, and bulk add or edit of the Chart of Accounts via CSV upload. Coverage is still incomplete for an AI-native user. Batch categorization is evidenced only by an article title, and the MCP write path (Beta) confirms each change individually, so there is no evidence of bulk actions through the agent or API. Missing for 10: documented bulk operations via API or MCP, detail on batch categorization scope and limits, bulk edit or delete across other item types (invoices, bills, transactions), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Instead of adding them one by one, you can upload a batch of entries all at once using Puzzle's CSV import template.
If you need to bulk add or edit your Chart of Accounts in Puzzle, you can do so by uploading a CSV file directly from your Company Settings.
